verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is a community remark that there is "no linear integration in free version," which implies a Linear integration exists on a paid tier. The documented "tasks" across the MCP server, CLI and SDK are Superset's own tasks, not synced issue-tracker tickets. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of any issue-tracker integration, any evidence for Jira, ClickUp or Monday.com, and evidence that agents can create or update tickets in those trackers directly.
